_source: BSM1_R2019b/asm1init.m (PAR1), the official BSM1 ASM1 kinetic and stoichiometric parameter set at 15 C. BSM1 uses these fixed 15 C values directly (no temperature correction). Keys are the aquakin ASM1 parameter names; values are the BSM1 PAR1 entries. Applied at the engine reference temperature (20 C) where the Arrhenius factor is unity, so the 15 C kinetics are used as published. KLa and SO saturation are listed for completeness; aquakin's build_bsm1 already uses these (KLa = 0,0,240,240,84 d^-1; SO_sat = 8 g/m3).
